title: Tekashi 6ix9ine Wants $20 Million To Get In Boxing Ring With Blueface
htmlContent:
Blueface has some opponents ahead of him in his next celebrity boxing match, but he really wants to get in the ring against Tekashi 6ix9ine. Over the last few weeks, both rappers have been going back and forth on social media. According to Hot New Hip Hop, their despite caused Blueface's Instagram account to be deleted from the platform after 6ix9ine reportedly reported it for bullying. Blueface would like to solve their issues in a boxing ring.

"I would love to whoop 6ix9ine’s ass, for sure," said Blueface when asked who he would be down to fight following his Kane Trujillo bout. "Fuck the height difference, we weigh about the same. So let’s set it up, if not him, then someone else in my weight class."

"He ain’t gonna take that, bro." Blueface told TMZ. "He wouldn’t take that if his mom was on her deathbed and it was her last breath and she said, 'Tekashi just fight Blueface and they’ll give me a new heart.'"

"He still wouldn’t do it."

On Thursday evening, 6ix9ine was on Clubhouse in the Sleepless in LA [Wack100 Invites 6ix9ine to Clubhouse].

During the question and answer period, Wack paused the room, and Blueface delivered a message to 6ix9ine.

"I hope you are training I'm going to beat that booty," said Blueface.

6ix9ine replied, "Yo, Blue we can meet up any day, anywhere. Wack will tell you I pulled upon him with no security. I like said, he got the money, he got $20 million as I said. We can do it, you heard?"

Blue replied, "You better be training!"

"I don't have to train you 6'4 and all bones like I said there's nothing to train for, and I'm ready for the fade," said 6ix9ine.

Let's see when both sides announce the bout!
